objective: Test whether deposit-matched fixed lot tranches and economically distinct uses of the frozen 12% aggregate-risk envelope improve stressed return, drawdown, admission breadth, and margin use relative to depositing more cash behind unchanged V7 economics.

proxy_development.source: already-consumed fresh-100 SIRA combined and six standalone real-tick ledgers

shared_path_limitations: standalone lifecycle merging omits replacement signals that would exist after a rejected lifecycle
changed protective-stop geometry cannot be reconstructed from lifecycle endpoints
margin, passive pending-order, shared equity, and RC4 path feedback require MT5 confirmation

changed_stop_geometry_envelopes.fixed_path_notional: hold the observed price path and multiply endpoint P/L by volume
changed_stop_geometry_envelopes.risk_r_invariant: hold observed stressed R and multiply by the proposed planned-risk dollars
changed_stop_geometry_envelopes.conservative_trade_value: minimum of fixed-path-notional and risk-R-invariant stressed P/L trade by trade

hypotheses.premise: Extra cash is only a margin and drawdown reserve while V7 keeps reference 100, base 0.01, position risk 4 dollars, and aggregate risk 12 dollars.
hypotheses.proxy: Use the fresh-100 combined lifecycle path unchanged and divide the same dollar outcomes by the larger deposit.

hypotheses.premise: Each 100-dollar deposit tranche starts one 0.01 lot risk unit; capital, volume, 4% position risk, 12% aggregate risk, and the 150%-of-start compounding step scale together.
hypotheses.proxy: Scale the accepted combined path by deposit/100; geometry and percentage outcomes should be invariant before broker nonlinearities.
hypotheses.ea_role: mandatory structural anchor regardless of proxy rank

hypotheses.premise: Initial lots equal deposit tranches, then every additional 150 stressed dollars adds exactly 0.01 lot rather than multiplying the whole initial base lot.
hypotheses.proxy: Replay combined lifecycle endpoints causally with day-frozen lot units and closed stressed P/L.

hypotheses.premise: Use deposit-proportional lots but split the 12% envelope into four 3% positions to trade some breadth for tighter individual stops.
Use deposit-proportional lots but split the 12% envelope into six 2% positions so every strategy can coexist, accepting materially tighter individual stops.
Treat each added 100-dollar deposit tranche as three additional frozen 4-dollar risk slots while retaining 0.01 lot and the original stop geometry per trade.
Keep three proportional 4% slots but prevent all three from concentrating in one index by capping each symbol bucket at two slots.

Start with deposit-proportional lot units, remove one 0.01 risk unit for new entries after closed stressed drawdown reaches 6% of starting deposit, and restore it only at a new stressed high-water mark.

economic_eligibility_at_both_200_and_300: conservative stressed net is positive in H1, H2, and full 2024
full conservative stressed maximum closed drawdown percent is no worse than LINEAR_CAPITAL
full conservative stressed-net-to-drawdown ratio exceeds LINEAR_CAPITAL
at least 12 admissions differ for a capacity policy or at least 20 entries change size for a sizing governor
proxy_to_ea_rule.diagnostic_fallback: If a group has no eligible hypothesis, still implement its highest-ranked hypothesis as DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY so the user-requested distinct EA paths receive causal MT5 evidence.
proxy_to_ea_rule.rank: maximize the minimum full-year conservative stressed-net-to-drawdown improvement over LINEAR_CAPITAL across deposits 200 and 300; tie by lower worst drawdown percent, then fewer interventions

ea_selection_metrics: actual and 2x-cost-stressed net USD and return percent
actual and stressed maximum closed drawdown USD and percent
maximum concurrent positions and overlap pairs
hard aggregate-risk, minimum-lot-risk, and margin skips
maximum margin dollars and percent of equity
MT5 report, order, deal, and logged lifecycle integrity

ea_selection_gate.implementation: MetaEditor build 6140 with 0 errors and 0 warnings; normal serial FPMarkets every-tick-real-tick runs; no safety, persistence, broker-identity, or foreign-exposure faults
ea_selection_gate.linear_100_anchor: LINEAR_CAPITAL at 100 must match DEPOSIT_ONLY_RESERVE at 100 after research identity normalization
ea_selection_gate.linear_scale_consistency: LINEAR_CAPITAL at 200 and 300 must keep full stressed return percent and stressed drawdown percent within 0.50 percentage point of LINEAR_CAPITAL at 100
ea_selection_gate.candidate_periods: positive stressed net in 2025 H1, H2, and full year at both 200 and 300
ea_selection_gate.candidate_risk: full stressed drawdown percent no worse than LINEAR_CAPITAL by more than 0.10 percentage point at either deposit
ea_selection_gate.candidate_efficiency: full stressed-net-to-drawdown ratio strictly exceeds LINEAR_CAPITAL at both deposits
ea_selection_gate.candidate_return_floor: full stressed return percent is at least 90% of LINEAR_CAPITAL at both deposits
ea_selection_gate.selection: At most one passing non-control policy, ranked by the smaller efficiency improvement across 200 and 300; tie by lower worst drawdown percent and then fewer interventions

stop_rules: No threshold, slot count, formula mixture, component weight, or nearby policy rescue after reading 2025.
If no non-control policy passes 2025, do not open 2026 confirmation and close with frozen V7 retained.
If a policy passes 2025, freeze it before 2026 confirmation and require the same direction of return and drawdown evidence at both deposits.
No result grants Live change or promotion authority.
